section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measurement instruments used in the study. For gratitude, the Gratitude Questionnaire-6 (GQ-6) was used, consisting of 6 items on a 7-point scale with a Cronbach's alpha of 0.76. Loneliness was measured using the 20-item Revised UCLA Loneliness Scale (third version) on a 4-point scale, with a Cronbach's alpha of 0.77. Social support was assessed with a shortened 12-question version of the Interpersonal Support Evaluation List, rated on a 4-point scale, achieving a Cronbach's alpha of 0.86.
